name: reply-style
_comment: CLAUDE.md's Output Style and its first line, checked on the final reply of every main-session turn (subagent reports go through SubagentStop, not this). Each item is a regular expression over the reply text, so it costs nothing when the reply already complies.

items.fix: CLAUDE.md: 'Address the user as "Jon" in every reply.' Your final message does not. Send it again addressed to Jon.

items.pattern: (?i)\A\W*(great question|good question|sure[!,.]|certainly[!,.]|absolutely[!,.]|of course[!,.]|i'?d be happy to|happy to help|let me (start|begin|take a look|walk you))
items.fix: CLAUDE.md, Output Style: no preamble. Start with the answer or the outcome; send the reply again without the opening pleasantry.

items.pattern: (?i)(let me know if|hope (this|that) helps|feel free to (ask|reach|let)|don'?t hesitate to|is there anything else)
items.fix: CLAUDE.md, Output Style: no postamble ('Let me know if...', 'Hope this helps'). End on the outcome; send the reply again without the closing offer.
